'''Ruto Graven''' was the [[Assistant Minister of Internal Affairs]] for [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]]. During the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]],<ref name="IoT" /> he was captured by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]<ref name="CSWE" /> alongside the [[Artist/Legends|artist]] [[Ela Sivel]] and [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Force]] officer [[Boraso]]. Graven was confident that their situation would be solved diplomatically by the Queen who had escaped to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], but ultimately managed to escape captivity alongside members of the [[Naboo Underground]].<ref name="IoT" />
